'''Teva Karne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] middle-level employee of the [[Procopian Transportation Ministry]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Karne sympathized with the Alliance in the conflict, and on occasion provided rebel cells within the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] with work permits, uniforms and public vehicles. He was also able to provide Rebels with changes of driving licenses and information on the ownership of private vehicles on the Procopia.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teva Karne first appeared as a possible ally for Rebel heroes in the campaign guide included in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The supplement was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]], and did not clarify Karne's [[Species/Legends|species]].
